headline: Nigeria Private Sector PMI Rises to 53.2 in October, Expanding for Fifth Month
summary: Nigeria's private sector Purchasing Managers' Index rose marginally to 53.2 points in October 2026 from 53.0 points in September, extending expansion to a fifth consecutive month.
why: PMI surveys provide early indications of business activity, output growth, and economic health in emerging market private sectors.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Growth in the PMI indicates continued private sector business expansion.
